stories.title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay declares open renovated Gandhi Memorial Museum in Madurai

en.title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay declares open renovated Gandhi Memorial Museum in Madurai
en.summary: Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister Vijay inaugurated a renovated Gandhi Memorial Museum in Madurai. The renovation project cost ₹10.25 crore and was executed by the Heritage Wing of the Public Works Department.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay launches Thaimaman Thanga Mothiram Thittam at Madurai

en.title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay launches Thaimaman Thanga Mothiram Thittam at Madurai
en.summary: Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister launched a scheme fulfilling a campaign promise that provides one-gram gold rings to all newborns delivered in state government hospitals starting from June 22.

stories.title: Supreme Court sets time frame for EC to decide TMC name, symbol dispute

en.title: Supreme Court sets time frame for EC to decide TMC name, symbol dispute
en.summary: The Supreme Court established a deadline for resolving a dispute over the TMC party's name and symbol, giving rival factions four weeks to complete pleadings and the Election Commission three months to decide.

stories.title: Supreme Court cancels Shiv Sena corporator Ramesh Mhatre’s bail

en.title: Supreme Court cancels Shiv Sena corporator Ramesh Mhatre's bail
en.summary: The Supreme Court revoked bail for Shiv Sena corporator Ramesh Mhatre, emphasizing that medical professionals deserve protection and cannot be subjected to violence.

stories.title: Ruckus in J&K Assembly over Statehood resolution, 4 protesting MLAs marshalled out

en.title: Ruckus in J&K Assembly over Statehood resolution, 4 protesting MLAs marshalled out
en.summary: BJP members disrupted proceedings in the Jammu and Kashmir Assembly during discussion of a statehood resolution, objecting to references to autonomy and special status as unconstitutional. Four protesting legislators were removed from the chamber.

stories.title: J&K Assembly passes CM Omar Abdullah’s resolution on Statehood

en.title: J&K Assembly passes CM Omar Abdullah's resolution on Statehood
en.summary: The Jammu and Kashmir Assembly approved a statehood resolution introduced by Chief Minister Omar Abdullah, with support from most parties including the Congress and the Peoples Democratic Party.

stories.title: J&K assembly passes resolution for urgent statehood restoration amid BJP walkout

en.title: J&K assembly passes resolution for urgent statehood restoration amid BJP walkout
en.summary: The Jammu and Kashmir Assembly passed a resolution calling for urgent restoration of statehood while BJP members boycotted the proceedings.

stories.title: Decide Trinamool symbol dispute in 4 months: Supreme Court tells Election Commission of India

en.title: Decide Trinamool symbol dispute in 4 months: Supreme Court tells Election Commission of India
en.summary: India's Supreme Court directed the Election Commission to resolve a dispute involving the Trinamool Congress party symbol within a four-month timeframe.

stories.title: Supreme Court To Hear Plea Against Acquittal Of 22 In Sohrabuddin Encounter Case

en.title: Supreme Court To Hear Plea Against Acquittal Of 22 In Sohrabuddin Encounter Case
en.summary: India's Supreme Court will review a challenge to the acquittal of 22 individuals in the Sohrabuddin encounter case. The court indicated it would examine specific witness statements related to the acquittal decision.

stories.title: J&K Assembly passes resolution demanding full statehood

en.title: J&K Assembly passes resolution demanding full statehood
en.summary: Jammu and Kashmir's assembly passed a resolution requesting full statehood status for the region.

stories.title: Supreme Court cancels Sena corporator’s bail in Thane doctors’ assault case

en.title: Supreme Court cancels Sena corporator's bail in Thane doctors' assault case
en.summary: India's Supreme Court revoked bail granted to a Shiv Sena corporator in connection with an assault case involving doctors in Thane.

stories.title: Watch: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay gives one-gram gold rings to newborns; who is eligible

en.title: Watch: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay gives one-gram gold rings to newborns; who is eligible
en.summary: Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister Vijay distributed one-gram gold rings to newborns as part of a welfare scheme, with specific eligibility criteria determining who receives the rings.

stories.title: Suzlon Energy shares fall 2% to near six-month low, down 15% in one month

en.title: Suzlon Energy shares fall 2% to near six-month low, down 15% in one month
en.summary: Suzlon Energy shares declined over 2% to approach their six-month low amid higher trading volumes and market weakness. Investors are monitoring the company's first quarter results and wind energy sector outlook.

stories.title: NSE shares fall 2%, slip below IPO price, but analysts’ target prices go up to Rs 2,050. Time to buy?

en.title: NSE shares fall 2%, slip below IPO price, but analysts' target prices go up to Rs 2,050. Time to buy?
en.summary: NSE share price fell below its Rs 1,785 IPO price, reducing market capitalisation to Rs 4.36 lakh crore. Multiple brokerages maintain positive outlooks with target prices ranging from Rs 1,950 to Rs 2,050, citing the company's market leadership and growth potential.

stories.title: PB Fintech shares can rally 91% after 2-day bloodbath, says Bernstein. Here’s why it remains bullish

en.title: PB Fintech shares can rally 91% after 2-day bloodbath, says Bernstein. Here's why it remains bullish
en.summary: PB Fintech shares rose 4% after Bernstein maintained a positive rating and Rs 2,310 target price despite recent declines following IRDAI's proposed restrictions on dark patterns. The brokerage expects revenue and profit pressure but anticipates cost reduction benefits.

stories.title: BSE shares fall 2%, down 30% in 4 months. Why Macquarie is bullish while Jefferies is cautious

en.title: BSE shares fall 2%, down 30% in 4 months. Why Macquarie is bullish while Jefferies is cautious
en.summary: BSE shares declined over 2% and are trading 30% below May highs amid broader market weakness. Analysts hold divergent views, with Macquarie optimistic about growth while Jefferies and Nuvama cite concerns including regulatory changes and operational impacts.

stories.title: Will RBI announce steep rate hikes? Nomura sees up to 50 bps increase by Dec, dismisses 125 bps hike fears

en.title: Will RBI announce steep rate hikes? Nomura sees up to 50 bps increase by Dec, dismisses 125 bps hike fears
en.summary: Nomura projects the RBI may increase interest rates by up to 50 basis points by December as food and energy costs rise, though it expects a measured approach rather than aggressive tightening.
